g.text: In urban Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, average earnings rise with age and peak at 55-59
Source: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, PSLM 2019-20 person file.
Sample: 678 earners in urban Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, persons aged 15-64 with annual earnings above zero. Grey dots: one earner each,
jittered up to 0.4 years left or right (1 outside the axis range not drawn).
Red markers: weighted mean earnings of each five-year age band at its midpoint, weighted by household weight (hhweight). Hollow
markers: thin bands with fewer than 30 earners (unweighted).
